description: Find scans that embed a given tracking or site key, such as an analytics ID or a CAPTCHA site key (tracker_type and key), sorted latest or oldest; paginated. A shared key often ties sites to one operator.

key.description: The tracking or site key itself, for example an analytics ID or a CAPTCHA site key.
key.title: Key

sort.description: Result order: latest or oldest; omit for the API's default.
sort.title: Sort

tracker_type.description: Tracker type of the key, for example google_analytics or facebook_pixel.
tracker_type.title: Tracker Type

name: search_tracking_key
title: Search Tracking Key
